Synthetic PDF fixtures generated with ReportLab (300 × 500 pt pages, 32 × 32 mm cyan rectangles, embedded Cyrillic font). No customer data.

- single.pdf: лицо [print1] above the single rectangle.
- reversed.pdf: top rectangle оборот [print2], bottom лицо [print1]; text emission order also differs from rectangle order.
- wrong.pdf: one rectangle labelled оборот [print2], used against an order selecting лицо.
- missing.pdf: one rectangle with no label.

The browser workflow serves the single fixture through the gifts.ru mock and the others through the test override. It serves assets from the checked-out source, never from a previous Pages build.
